Name: An Affair with Robin (English)
Author: Allening
Description:
-Content-
A unique immersive story expansion for Robin, detailing the cracks in her marriage to Demetrius. Adds 18 exclusive heart events for Robin, fully unfolding the secret affection between “you” and Robin.
-Warning-
This mod contains adult-oriented storylines and content. Please consider whether it suits your preferences.

-Installation-
Latest version of SMAPI
Required files
Extract the original mod to /Mods folder
Download this mod and copy files over to the inside of the Affair with Robin mod and [u]overwrite[/u] the files in there
Run the game using SMAPI

There is one file in this mod, and it's the i18n folder and the default.json in there is the only file modded.
